name: Continuity QC
purpose: Validate selected media against authoritative continuity state and adjacent shots.
scope: Bounded finishing capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for continuity_qc.
Execute the bounded operation: Validate selected media against authoritative continuity state and adjacent shots.
Apply continuity_qc-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to studio_orchestrator.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run continuity_qc on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask continuity_qc to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
